packageRules.description: Pin Python to 3.9 to match macOS system Python from Xcode CLT — see CLAUDE.md.

Freeze the devcontainer's primary Python (the python feature's `version`) at the exact Xcode CLT patch — the built-in devcontainer manager must not bump it. The latest-Python pin (`additionalVersions`) is bumped by the customManager below. See CLAUDE.md.

customManagers.description: Keep the devcontainer's latest-Python pin (`additionalVersions`) current. Only the annotated line is matched, so the frozen `version` pin is never touched.

Keep the molecule CI job's Python pin (`python-version` under setup-python) current — should track the devcontainer's `additionalVersions` so local dev and CI agree on the interpreter. The 3.9 pin on the python/bash jobs is silenced by the packageRule above and never matched here.
